name: Kuga Masaya
source: A young man who was born without a father and raised just by his mother. His mother passed away at a time when he studied. He grew splendidly and gained the medical license without repetition.
translation: A young man who was born without a father and raised just by his mother. His mother passed away at a time when he studied. He grew splendidly and gained the medical license without repetition.
